summary: Hubbell Inc filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $1.9 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes in three tranches: $500M 4.650% notes due 2031, $700M 4.900% notes due 2033, and $700M 5.150% notes due 2036. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration statement. Net proceeds of ~$1,869.6M, after underwriting discount and expenses, will be used to fund the previously announced acquisition of NSI Industries, repay NSI debt, and pay related fees. The underwriters are J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, and HSBC. This is a debt capital markets transaction, not a standalone special situation; the acquisition itself is not detailed in this filing.
